name: Quorum Of Five
hint: Six takes — five bodies standing still and one walking out. The first door needs THREE plates at once (p1 at x=4, p2 at x=8, p3 at x=12, each 2 wide and 4 apart so no single body spans two). Behind it, plate p4 at x=20 powers the lift, and up on the deck switch s1 opens the last door for 6 seconds. TAKES 1-3: stand on p1, then p2, then p3, one per take — each take you simply walk to the next plate and stop, because the earlier Echoes are already holding the ones behind you. At the end of take 3 all three are held and door d1 at x=16 is open, but you are pinned on p3. TAKE 4: walk through the open doorway and stand on p4 at x=20..22; that powers lift m1 at x=24..28. TAKE 5: Echo D holds p4 so the lift is climbing; board it at about t=2.6s while the deck is still near the floor, ride from y=19 to y=12, step across the 1-unit gap onto the deck at x=29..39, walk to s1 at x=31 and press it. That opens door d2 at x=34 for 6 seconds — not long enough to matter to you, because this take is for recording the press. TAKE 6: all five are held. Run right through d1, past p4, board the lift, ride up, and Echo E presses s1 at about t=7.5s as you reach the deck; walk right through d2 while it is up and into the exit at x=36.5.

dialogue.text: Five plates, five of you, one door at the top.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: The room was built for a crew of six. It still is. You are just all of them now.
